name: WAR-State
description: Raw deterministic audit pass for normal evidence matching. Use when you want fast, explainable checks without heavier judgment.

name: Light-State
description: Fast lenient screening that flags only clear evidence gaps and preserves reasonable wording.

name: Person-State
description: Contextual AI review for meaning, intent, transferable experience, and reasonable paraphrases.

name: Strict WAR+AI-State
description: Independent deterministic and AI passes combined conservatively for high-stakes decisions.
